notBlocking.summary: On Craft 4 the new parseEnv calls behave differently from the Craft 5.11.3 the script ran against, and the changelog lines over-claim for the declared floor (craftcms/cms ^4.5.0): Craft 4.5.0–4.16 resolve only a whole $VAR and @alias (not ${VAR} or $VAR/…, added in 4.17.0), and every Craft 4 leaves an unset $VAR literal, so Videocinch’s “an unset node-path variable means no node prefix” holds on Craft 5 only (on Craft 4 it fails loudly with “$NAME: not found”).
notBlocking.repro: php d690b-gate/craft45-parseenv-only.php dl/App-4.5.0.php -> "${G_TOOL} -> '${G_TOOL}'", "$G_BIN/fake-tool -> '$G_BIN/fake-tool'", "$G_UNSET -> '$G_UNSET'"; php d690b-gate/craft4-parseenv-probe.php dl/App-4x.php (videocinch) -> nodePath $G_UNSET: "exec: $G_UNSET: not found"
notBlocking.acceptance: Either scope the changelog wording (“${VAR} on Craft 5 and 4.17+”) or accept as written; no code change needed.
